carmen (Customer): Hey—we're seeing schema validation errors when calling tools via the OpenAI-compatible tool_call path. Worked last week, now failing with a validation error on 'mode' and also the tool response is a plain string not JSON. Posting request + resp below so you can repro quickly.

sylvie (Support): Thanks @carmen, can you paste the exact request and the error body?

carmen (Customer): Copied minimal repro (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-tool-1\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"create note\"}],\"tool_call\":{\"tool_name\":\"note:create\",\"arguments\":{\"title\":\"Q1 plan\",\"mode\":\"rw\"}}}'
```

Error returned (400):
```json
{
  "error":{
    "message":"tool_call.arguments.mode: invalid enum value 'rw' (allowed: 'read','write')",
    "type":"validation_error"
  }
}
```

oliver (SDK): Two immediate smells: (1) field name is `tool_name` vs our OpenAI compatibility layer expecting `tool`, and (2) enum alias `rw` should be normalized to `write`. Which variant is the customer using? SDK vs raw API?

carmen (Customer): We're using a forked SDK (internal) that maps `tool` -> `tool_name` in the payload. We did that b/c the original tool registry used `tool_name`. It used to work because backend accepted aliases, but after the recent validation tightening it fails.

nate (Eng-ML): Confirming: we recently landed stricter schema validation for tool_call to prevent ambiguous fields. The canonical shape is:
```json
{
  "tool_call":{"tool":"note:create","arguments":{"title":"Q1 plan","mode":"write"}}
}
```
We also removed implicit enum aliasing (e.g., `rw` -> `write`) to avoid silent behavior differences.

sam (SRE): Customer is hitting this in production and seeing ~2% error rate spike for tool calls since the change. Is there a safe fallback we can recommend while we triage?

sylvie (Support): Temporary workaround: normalize aliases client-side and rename `tool_name` -> `tool` before sending. If they can't change SDK fast, we can add a temporary compatibility layer at the load balancer to rewrite the field. Need eng signoff.

nate (Eng-ML): Agreed on two options: 1) customer-side patch (preferred), 2) short-lived compat route in gateway that maps `tool_name` to `tool` and maps enum aliases `rw` -> `write`, `r` -> `read`. I can ship a guarded flag to the compat path with audit logging.

oliver (SDK): I'll open a PR in our public SDK to normalize enums and accept `tool_name` as alias for one release. But we should not keep that forever.

carmen (Customer): For completeness, another weirdness: when our tool (note service) responds it returns the body as a string: "created: <id>" instead of JSON object { id: "<id>", url: "..." }. Redwood's tool-call response parser then fails to parse the tool output and the chat reply shows raw string. Example response from tool endpoint: 
```json
{
  "tool": "note:create",
  "output": "created: 12345"
}
```
Expected: `output` should be a JSON object that conforms to the tool's declared output schema.

nate (Eng-ML): Right — the spec requires structured tool outputs for the router to extract fields and to allow post-processing. We can add a soft check that logs a warning instead of hard-failing for a short period, but that weakens guarantees.

sam (SRE): Logs show the hard fail is the schema validation on request side not the tool output parse in most failures. But we do have a handful of events where downstream parsing failed and produced a 500 in the tool adapter. Need to track both.

sylvie (Support): Action items: 
• @oliver: PR to SDK to accept `tool_name` and normalize enums (ETA: end of day).
• @nate: temporary gateway compat mapping + audit logs (ETA: 2 business days).
• @carmen: if you can, patch the internal SDK to rename `tool_name` -> `tool` and convert `rw` -> `write` for a fast fix.
• @sam: add dashboard alert for tool_call validation errors spike and tag affected customer.

incidents-bot: Created incident #INC-2026-toolcall-schema with severity: medium, owner: eng-ml/nate.

carmen (Customer): Thanks all — we'll patch client now and test. Can you keep me posted when the gateway change is live so we can remove the workaround? :pray:

sylvie (Support): Will do. Marking this as escalated -> eng-ml. I'll follow up with timeline and postmortem once resolved. :white_check_mark:
